summary: @or-sdk/auth 0.38.3 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle unrelated to the SDK
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array rotator, char-code decode table, hex-mangled identifiers such as MmgoCP / etDiOOB / hc1jfK9, filename that does not describe any auth functionality). The setup.mjs + math_init.js pair sits at the tarball root, is not referenced or imported by any file under dist/, and is disjoint from the auth SDK code advertised by README, CHANGELOG, and dist/. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (fetching a second language runtime at install time specifically to execute a bundled, obfuscated payload under it) evades scanners that only follow Node-resolved code and runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's host as a side effect of npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
